title: 3.2.B3 Build-Up — Moon Orbits Earth
description: Add a gray Moon sphere that orbits the Earth using the anchor offset pattern from B0.

steps.title: Create the moon Sphere
steps.instructions: In setup(), add `moon = new Sphere(5.2, 0, 0, 0.3)` placed near earth. Set its color to 'lightgray'.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sphere section.

steps.title: Moon orbits earth using the anchor pattern
steps.instructions: In draw(), use the anchor offset: `moon.position.x = earth.position.x + Math.cos(radians(frameCount * 2)) * 1.2` and `moon.position.z = earth.position.z + Math.sin(radians(frameCount * 2)) * 1.2`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and review the anchor offset pattern in the B0 reading.

requirements.title: moon is a Sphere
requirements.description: A new Sphere is assigned to moon.

requirements.title: moon uses anchor offset pattern
requirements.description: moon.position.x is set using earth.position.x plus an offset.
